name: Monolingual Spanish encoders: RoBERTa-BNE (MarIA) base/large and BETO
links: RoBERTa-BNE / MarIA: HF PlanTL-GOB-ES/roberta-base-bne, PlanTL-GOB-ES/roberta-large-bne (marked deprecated; maintained successors under huggingface.co/BSC-LT); code/eval github.com/PlanTL-GOB-ES/lm-spanish; paper Gutierrez-Fandino et al. 2022, 'MarIA: Spanish Language Models', Procesamiento del Lenguaje Natural 68. BETO: HF dccuchile/bert-base-spanish-wwm-cased, dccuchile/bert-base-spanish-wwm-uncased; code github.com/dccuchile/beto; paper Canete et al., PML4DC @ ICLR 2020 (arXiv:2308.02976). Spanish NLI checkpoint: Recognai/bert-base-spanish-wwm-cased-xnli (BETO fine-tuned on Spanish XNLI). Related evaluation: Agerri & Agirre 2022, 'Lessons learned from the evaluation of Spanish Language Models' (arXiv:2212.08390). Newer BSC alternative: BSC-LT/MrBERT (arXiv:2602.21379) [uncertain].
license_access: Open-weight. RoBERTa-BNE: Apache 2.0 (PlanTL repos flagged deprecated but still downloadable). BETO: CC BY 4.0 (authors note possible license incompatibilities in training data).
track_coverage: T2 ES only. Not suitable for T1, T3, or T4 mixed views (English/Basque sides would be poorly represented).
basque_quality: None - Spanish-only vocabularies and pretraining; Basque is not covered.
cross_lingual_robustness: Not applicable to mixed-language pairs: large expected gap (EN side degraded, EU side essentially out-of-vocabulary semantics). Use only on Spanish-Spanish inputs.
architecture: Encoder-only cross-encoders. RoBERTa-BNE: RoBERTa base (12 layers) / large (24 layers), byte-level BPE vocab 50,262, pretrained on 570 GB of deduplicated Spanish web text from the National Library of Spain crawls 2009-2019 (201M documents, ~135.7B tokens). BETO: BERT-base with whole-word masking, ~31k SentencePiece vocab, 2M training steps on a ~3B-word Spanish corpus [uncertain on corpus size]. For DiCo: '<es_a> [SEP] <es_b>' -> 4-way linear head.
compute: Trivial: full fine-tuning of any of them fits in 24 GB (large in bf16 at batch 32); T2 train is 3042 rows, under a minute per epoch; multi-seed sweeps cheap.
sample_efficiency: ~1.3k reversible source pairs is small for a 4-way head from MLM weights; expect noticeable seed variance, especially for RoBERTa-large (occasional degenerate runs). Mitigate with intermediate training on Spanish XNLI / translated MNLI (or start from Recognai/bert-base-spanish-wwm-cased-xnli for BETO), 3-5 seeds, early stopping on dev.
reported_results: EvalES (lm-spanish repo), XNLI-es accuracy: RoBERTa-large-BNE 0.8263, RoBERTa-base-BNE 0.8016, BETO 0.8130, mBERT 0.7876, BERTIN 0.7890, Electricidad 0.7878; PAWS-X F1: 0.9150 / 0.9020 / 0.8930 / 0.9000; STS combined: 0.8411 / 0.8533 / 0.8159 / 0.8164. BETO paper: XNLI 82.01 (cased), 80.15 (uncased) vs best mBERT 78.50. Multilingual comparison: XLM-R-large translate-train XNLI-es 84.69, mDeBERTa 83.27 ('Lost in Variation', CoNLL 2025), i.e. both above the best Spanish monolingual model; Agerri & Agirre (2022) conclude multilingual models from large companies fare better than monolingual Spanish ones. No phrase-level NLI or DiCo numbers exist.
pilot_dico_results: Not evaluated (LREC 2026 pilot was English-only; best DeBERTa-v3-base 0.75 / 0.84 / 0.79).
consistency_guarantee: none (plain classifier; consistency must come from joint decoding / antisymmetric head / consistency loss)
negative_other_handling: Learned as the fourth softmax class; can produce NEG on one direction of a reversible pair only. Use a pair-level NEG gate and joint consistent-pair decoding, optionally pooling p(NEG) with multilingual models across views of the same pair_id.
metric_tradeoff: Expected W-F1 on T2 slightly below XLM-R-large / mDeBERTa NLI checkpoints (XNLI-es gap ~2 points) [uncertain]; consistency metrics depend on the decoding layer, not the backbone. Mostly useful as ensemble diversity for T2.
integration: Drop-in: AutoModelForSequenceClassification.from_pretrained('PlanTL-GOB-ES/roberta-large-bne' or 'dccuchile/bert-base-spanish-wwm-cased', num_labels=4, id2label=ID2LABEL, label2id=LABEL2ID). For Recognai/bert-base-spanish-wwm-cased-xnli the 3-way NLI head must be replaced (ignore_mismatched_sizes=True) or mapped. Restrict to Track 2 configs; REVERSE_PERM aggregation unchanged.
ensemble_compatibility: Yes - 4-class softmax; temperature-scale on dev before pooling.
inference_cost: Negligible: seconds for the T2 test set on one GPU.
rules_disclosure: Disclose: open-weight, encoder-only, fine-tuned, external NLI data (XNLI-es / translated MNLI) if used, ensembling. Licenses unproblematic (Apache 2.0, CC BY 4.0); note the PlanTL repos are deprecated, so pin the exact revision.
contamination: Pretraining is Spanish web (BNE crawl 2009-2019) and Spanish Wikipedia/OPUS-style text for BETO; DiCo Spanish phrases are new translations of English iSTS/PhrasIS phrases (headlines/image captions), so direct overlap is unlikely; no labels leak [uncertain]. Intermediate XNLI data is unrelated to PhrasIS.
structural_cue_dependence: No - model sees only the two phrases.
priority: P2 (only as extra T2 ensemble members after multilingual XLM-R-large / mDeBERTa NLI checkpoints are in place)
expected_gain: Low. Published XNLI-es numbers show RoBERTa-large-BNE (82.6) below XLM-R-large (84.7) and mDeBERTa (83.3); expected single-model result on T2 is at or slightly below multilingual baselines, with possibly +0.5-1 W-F1 from ensembling for diversity [uncertain]. Not usable for any other track.
